## What does this change?

- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] I cited a source for every entry
- [ ] I may legally share this material (public domain, my own collecting, or with permission; never a modern collection copied whole)
- [ ] Whatever I collected from a person has their consent (`consent`), and charms are not presented as medical advice
- [ ] If I touched `src/`: `npm test` passes and `node scripts/build.mjs` was run
